text: Working with producers on behalf of buyers means each enquiry starts with someone who knows what is made where, and on what terms.
title: Producer access

text: Each destination market buys, ships and clears cargo differently. Knowing those differences is part of arranging a trade that runs as agreed.
title: Market knowledge

text: Supply is planned around repeat requirements rather than single cargoes, so the same grade can keep moving through market cycles.
title: Continuity of supply

title: Coordinated from Singapore
